verses.english: Another Discourse on the First Absorption

verses.pali: “Pañcime, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharituṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without giving up these five qualities you can’t enter and remain in the first absorption.

verses.pali: Āvāsamacchariyaṁ, kulamacchariyaṁ, lābhamacchariyaṁ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṁ, akataññutaṁ akataveditaṁ.
verses.english: Stinginess with dwellings, families, material things, praise, and lack of gratitude and thankfulness.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhamme appahāya abhabbo paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharituṁ.
verses.english: Without giving up these five qualities you can’t enter and remain in the first absorption.

verses.pali: Pañcime, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharituṁ.
verses.english: But after giving up these five qualities you can enter and remain in the first absorption.

verses.pali: Āvāsamacchariyaṁ, kulamacchariyaṁ, lābhamacchariyaṁ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṁ, akataññutaṁ akataveditaṁ.
verses.english: Stinginess with dwellings, families, material things, praise, and lack of gratitude and thankfulness.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhamme pahāya bhabbo paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharitun”ti.
verses.english: After giving up these five qualities you can enter and remain in the first absorption.”
